name: Major Project Part-1
description: In this project, the student must meet with the supervisor at least once a week to discuss the progress. The supervisor will suggest the project's scope, methodology, tools, and techniques per the project's requirements. By the end of major project part-1, the student should have completed a significant part of the work required for producing a high-quality master's thesis in industrial engineering and operations research.
